summary: Re-verified the Navbar/AuthModal id-rename fixes plus full backend regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (feed, energy-packages, cTrader isConfigured=true, Mayar isConfigured=true, /api/auth/password register+login+wrong-password+short-password+invalid-email+no-consent, password-reset request, persistence via /api/auth/login, and /api/_llm/economic-event returning a valid answer via openai/gpt-5.4). Frontend: FIRST RUN FAILED - the live preview was still serving the OLD bundle (header 'Masuk' button rendered the Google 'G' with id btn-nav-google-login; data-testid btn-nav-login absent) even though /app/frontend/src was already fixed. Root cause found: vite.config.ts sets hmr:false and watch:null, which disables Vite's file watcher, so the dev server keeps serving the module transform it compiled at process start and NEVER picks up source edits (curl of http://localhost:3000/src/components/Navbar.tsx returned the old btn-nav-google-login JSX while the on-disk file had 0 occurrences). After `supervisorctl restart frontend` every requested assertion passed: header button has id/data-testid btn-nav-login with the lucide LogIn icon, zero Google brand-color paths, and 0 DOM occurrences of btn-nav-google-login / input-google-email / input-manual-password / 'Lanjutkan dengan Google' / 'ATAU MASUKKAN EMAIL GOOGLE'. Modal renders the new form (title 'Masuk ke Scrolic' + cTrader badge, T&C checkbox #input-legal-consent, #input-email [data-testid input-auth-email], #input-password [data-testid input-auth-password], #btn-submit-email-login [data-testid btn-auth-submit], 'Masuk / Daftar dengan Email', 'Lupa Password?'). Submit is disabled before consent and enabled after. Live registration with uitest1787987895@scrolic.com succeeded: POST /api/auth/password -> 200, modal closed, header login button replaced by the logged-in navbar (energy pill, notifications, 'Posisi Saya'). Zero console errors, zero error elements.

integration_issues.flow: Preview serving stale code (THE user-reported 'old Google login modal' bug)
integration_issues.issue: vite.config.ts server config has `hmr: false` and `watch: null`. With the watcher disabled Vite never invalidates its module graph, so the dev server serves whatever it transformed at process start. Any subsequent edit to Navbar.tsx/AuthModal.tsx is invisible in the preview until the frontend process is manually restarted - reproduced directly: on-disk Navbar.tsx had 0 'btn-nav-google-login' while both http://localhost:3000/src/components/Navbar.tsx and the public preview URL still returned the old JSX with id 'btn-nav-google-login'. This fully explains why the user kept seeing the old login UI after fixes were applied. Recommended fix: remove `watch: null` (and re-enable hmr, or at minimum keep the watcher so full-reload invalidation works); until then every source change requires `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`.

rca_of_the_issue: The user's 'old Google login modal' is a stale-serving problem, not a source problem. /app/frontend/src has zero occurrences of any Google-auth artifact, yet the Vite dev server (vite.config.ts: server.watch = null, server.hmr = false) never invalidates its transform cache, so it returned the pre-edit Navbar.tsx module (containing id='btn-nav-google-login' and the Google G SVG) from both localhost:3000 and the public preview URL. Verified by diffing curl output against the on-disk file (disk: 0 matches; served: 1 match). A single `supervisorctl restart frontend` made the corrected Navbar/AuthModal appear immediately and every acceptance criterion passed. Fix the vite watch config and redeploy/CDN-invalidate production.
